mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE crosses above 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals weakening household demand, which reduces earnings growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS declines by > 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production exceeding 1% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO declines by > 1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the civilian unemployment rate above 4.0% combined with a 3-month decline in average weekly hours worked (HOUST) signals a dual labor market weakening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.0% AND HOUST falls over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when both UNRATE > 4.0% and HOUST declines over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% combined with a 3-month decline in personal income (GDPC1) signals a demand shock, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls > 2% AND GDPC1 falls over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when both RSAFS falls > 2% and GDPC1 declines over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production exceeding 1% combined with a 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 1% signals a supply-demand shock, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls > 1% AND RSAFS falls > 1% over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when both INDPRO falls > 1% and RSAFS falls > 1% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
